card.name: Last letter of CgA and similar codes
card.fires_on: The final letter of a short abbreviation that has been split into pieces, mainly the A in CgA (chromogranin A) in proton pump inhibitor labels. Also the C in KRAS G12C.

modes.label: CgA repeat mention
modes.description: The A of CgA in the advice to stop the acid-reducing drug before testing and to repeat the test if initial CgA is high.
modes.example: consider repeating the test if initial Cg<<A>> levels are high

modes.description: The last letter of a gene mutation name such as G12C.
